scientific_question: Before training on two arrival regimes, determine whether one legal early memory intervention can recover F60 failures under both original order and local four-event rotation and whether the causal public candidate feature vector exhibits beneficial-versus-harmful aliasing.

method.baseline: Exact unchanged F60 _f60_step at every public event; compute one-step counterfactual from each legal ACTION.actions native successor and exact frozen F60 suffix.
method.question_usage: Synthetic question used ONLY offline to label terminal answer correctness; never input to any online policy or feature.
method.public_features: Use frozen F71 twelve-dimensional public-only feature vector for a deterministic eight-decimal candidate signature; do not train, fit, rank, or select a candidate using labels.
method.one_step_search: Exhaust all 72 public indices and every unique native source-legal alternative (excluding unchanged F60 state), in ascending order; no fixed checkpoints. Track first rescue index only as read-only forensic evidence.
method.causal_guard: Independent original 72-prefix causal memory auditor must verify every first certified rescue, for both arrival regimes.
method.source_guard: Every synthetic public graph answer unique; 12 records * 12B memory; unchanged source structure under F76.
method.inference_limit: If a failure is not rescued by one action, report unresolved under the bounded search only, NOT scientific impossibility.
method.evaluation_commitment: A PASS means diagnostic correctness, not a positive learned-model result; no source/threshold modifications after observing results.
